segments.name: Personal care
segments.description: The company sells cleanly-formulated, sustainably-designed personal care products for babies to adults through retail and ecommerce channels.
segments.evidence: Our Chief Executive Officer, as the chief operating decision maker, organizes the Company, manages resource allocations, and measures performance on the basis of one operating segment.

revenueModel.text: The company earns revenue from retailers and third-party ecommerce customers purchasing its products, and previously from consumers directly through Honest.com.
revenueModel.evidence: We have retail partnerships with leading retailers that sell our products through brick and mortar stores and on their own websites.

changes.text: In 2025, the company exited Honest.com fulfillment, apparel, and retail and online stores in Canada under its Powering Honest Growth initiative.
changes.evidence: Powering Honest Growth is aimed at improving simplicity, focus and profitability, which includes exiting certain lower margin, non-strategic categories and channels, including exiting Honest.com fulfillment and apparel, as well as exiting retail and online stores in Canada

changes.text: In 2023, the company executed a broad-based Transformation Initiative to build the brand and drive growth in higher-margin areas of the portfolio.
changes.evidence: In 2023, we executed a broad-based Transformation Initiative designed to build the Honest brand and drive growth in higher-margin areas of the portfolio, strengthen our cost structure, drive focus on the most productive areas of our business, deliver greater impact from brand-building investments, and improve executional excellence across the enterprise.
